title: Turn Your Leftover Turkey Into These Turkey and Egg Rice Bowls
contentHtml:
A 5 a.m. duck breakfast in Tokyo inspired these 20-minute rice bowls with leftover roast turkey, glossy sweet-and-salty dashi, and soft ribbons of egg.

These simple turkey and egg rice bowls are based on the duck and egg rice boxes I had at 5AM one morning near Ueno Station in Tokoy. Ramen Kamo to Negi is better known for its intense noodle broth made with nothing but roasted duck bones and spring...
